title: Orientation and incidence numbers on a cell complex
body_html:
Orientation and incidence numbers

For a locally finite regular CW complex $X$ we fix a family of incidence numbers

$$[E : F] \in \mathbb{Z}, \qquad E, F \in [\![X]\!],$$

supported on codim-1 face pairs and satisfying

  • $[E : F] = 0$ whenever $E \not\preceq F$;
  • $[E : F] = 0$ whenever $\dim F \neq \dim E + 1$;
  • the chain-complex axiom $\partial^2 = 0$: for any pair $D, F$ with $\dim F = \dim D + 2$,

$$\sum_{E \in [\![X]\!]} [D : E] \cdot [E : F] = 0.$$

Such a family is called an orientation of $X$.

Regularity

An orientation is regular if $[E : F] \in \{+1, -1\}$ whenever $E \preceq F$ and $\dim F = \dim E + 1$. Combinatorially this matches the topological condition that each attaching map is an embedding onto its image; every regular CW complex admits a regular orientation.

$G$-equivariance

When a group $G$ acts cellularly on $X$, an orientation is $G$-equivariant when

$$[g \cdot E : g \cdot F] = [E : F], \qquad g \in G, \ E, F \in [\![X]\!].$$

Equivariance is the appropriate condition for connected acting groups (no sign character); disconnected acting groups may act through a sign character on $\mathbb{Z}$, but the paper's setting is connected.

Downstream use

The orientation feeds into the boundary of the cellular chain complex of a cosheaf: see [[node:representations.chain_complex_C_dot]].

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Orientation
lean_refs.signature:
class Orientation (X : Type*) [PartialOrder X] [AbstractCellComplex X]
    [IsLocallyFinite X] where
  /-- Incidence number `[E : F] ∈ ℤ`. -/
  incidence : X → X → ℤ
  /-- Vanishes if `E` is not a face of `F`. -/
  incidence_eq_zero_of_not_le :
    ∀ {E F : X}, ¬ E ≤ F → incidence E F = 0
  /-- Vanishes if the codimension is not 1. -/
  incidence_eq_zero_of_dim_ne :
    ∀ {E F : X}, AbstractCellComplex.dim F ≠ AbstractCellComplex.dim E + 1 →
      incidence E F = 0
  /-- The chain-complex condition `∂² = 0`. -/
  boundary_sq :
    ∀ {D F : X}, AbstractCellComplex.dim F = AbstractCellComplex.dim D + 2 →
      (IsLocallyFinite.finite_faces F).toFinset.sum
        (fun E => incidence D E * incidence E F) = 0

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.IsRegular
lean_refs.signature:
class IsRegular (X : Type*) [PartialOrder X] [AbstractCellComplex X]
    [IsLocallyFinite X] [Orientation X] : Prop where
  incidence_eq_pm_one :
    ∀ {E F : X}, E ≤ F →
      AbstractCellComplex.dim F = AbstractCellComplex.dim E + 1 →
      Orientation.incidence E F = 1 ∨ Orientation.incidence E F = -1

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.IsGEquivariantOrientation
lean_refs.signature:
class IsGEquivariantOrientation (G : Type*) [Group G] (X : Type*)
    [PartialOrder X] [AbstractCellComplex X] [IsLocallyFinite X]
    [MulAction G X] [GCellComplex G X]
    [Orientation X] : Prop where
  incidence_smul :
    ∀ (g : G) (E F : X),
      Orientation.incidence (g • E) (g • F) = Orientation.incidence E F
